topPRs.title: agents: Add specification consistency reviewer
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Add a repository-local consistency reviewer for specification reviews. The reviewer checks for conflicting requirements, stale statements, incomplete exhaustive lists, and differences between prose and pseudocode. It traces related sections beyond the changed lines and requires evidence for each finding.

The reviewer treats explicit hard fork changes as expected behavior, not contradictions. It checks scope, activation conditions, and amendments before it reports a conflict. Each finding identifies both source locations and explains why the statements cannot both apply.

The agent uses `model: inherit` and inherits available tools. Its instructions limit it to review without edits and exclude style, implementation quality, and protocol design reviews.
